name: Women Of Virtue
overview: Scripture highlights the profound value and dignity of a woman of virtue, portraying her as a precious crown to her husband and one whose worth is far above rubies. Such a woman demonstrates strength and honor as her clothing, rejoicing in the future, and extends her hands generously to the poor and needy. The instruction and example found in Proverbs 31, including the wisdom imparted by King Lemuel’s mother, affirm the godly character and influence of virtuous women within the family and community. Honoring parents, as commanded in Exodus 20:12, further underscores the foundation of respect and godliness that supports a woman’s virtuous life.
